messages:
alex.k: Quick heads-up — saw a bug in the async python SDK where error wrappers drop the response body and request metadata after a retry. Breaks downstream error parsing.

nidhi: can you paste a tiny repro and the client version?

alex.k: minimal repro:
```py
async with AsyncRedwoodClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.post('/v1/secure', json={'x':1})
```
Server returns 401 on first attempt, our retry fires but auth header not re-attached; second try 401 too. The raised exception has no .raw_body and .status is None.

log:
```
WARNING retrying request to /v1/secure count=1
ResponseError: HTTP error during request
  status: None
  body: <missing>
```

ryan: sounds like aiohttp consumed the stream earlier (ClientPayloadError style). We should read response.content before raising and stash bytes.

alex.k: yes two separate fixes: (1) ensure auth header is preserved/resent on retry, (2) wrapper must always expose stable fields so user error handling doesn't break.

nidhi: agree. Proposed wrapper contract (typing):
```py
class ApiHttpError(Exception):
    status_code: int
    raw_body: bytes  # never None (b'' if empty)
    parsed_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]  # lazy property, None if parse fails
    request_id: Optional[str]
    url: str
    __cause__: Optional[BaseException]
```
User example:
```py
try:
    await client.post(...)
except ApiHttpError as e:
    if e.status_code == 401:
        start_login_flow()
    body = e.parsed_json or json.loads(e.raw_body.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))
```

ryan: implementation note: call await resp.read() in the catch path inside retry loop, stash bytes onto resp (e.g., resp._cached_body) before any wrapping. Make parsed_json a @property with caching so we don't parse on every access. Also preserve original exception as __cause__.

nidhi: also update typing/docs: raise ApiHttpError explicitly in docstrings and export in package __all__ so clients can catch it by name. Current stubs that say "raises: Exception" are unhelpful.

alex.k: test requests: add pytest unit `test_retry_preserve_body_and_metadata` that simulates a streaming read error then retry, assert wrapper.status_code == 401, wrapper.raw_body is bytes, wrapper.parsed_json keeps arrays/objects intact (especially 422 problem-json with errors list).

ryan: will draft a small PR. CI bot, please run the branch tests once pushed.

ci-bot: build #5042 queued for branch fix/async-error-wrapping

nidhi: file an issue and assign @ryan. Add a short customer-facing note: additive fields only, no breaking API changes for catching by Exception; but recommend catching ApiHttpError for structured handling.

alex.k: also update examples/async-auth to show catching ApiHttpError instead of bare Exception and reading parsed_json safely.

ryan: timeline: PR today, tests tomorrow, patch release candidate if QA green. :+1:
